summary.text: Jake Vogel is the Republican candidate for Missouri State Senate District 6 in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the August 4 Republican primary.
According to his campaign website, he is a U.S. Army veteran who works in his family's central Missouri beverage distribution business.

paragraphs.text: Jake Vogel says on his campaign website that he comes from a five-generation family in central Missouri whose business began in 1892 and later became a Coca-Cola franchisee distributorship.
He states that he enlisted in the U.S. Army after the September 11 attacks, completed the Ranger Indoctrination Program and Ranger School, and was honorably discharged.
After leaving the military he returned to the family business, and he says he has been involved in mentorship programs, the Jefferson City Public School Foundation and the SSM board.
He and his wife, Maria, are raising three children, according to the site.
